1. the prognosis of colo-rectal cancer is determined mainly by the extent of the disease at the time of diagnosis and by the quality of surgery; 2. the prognosis can be improved by the application of radical surgical principles; 3. the prognosis can further be improved by a better selection of patients for adjuvant therapy.
